help:
Assist Scenario Lab
Offline only; never sends device commands.
  assist-lab evaluate INPUT.json [--format text|json|html|junit] [--lang en|ru|de|es]
  assist-lab import-ha EVENTS.json --session ID --platform NAME [--synthetic]
Exit: 0 accepted, 1 failed, 2 invalid input, 3 incomplete evidence. See docs/en/guide.md.
title: Voice scenario evidence
synthetic: Synthetic fixture — not measured device performance.
declared: Imported observations — source claims were not independently verified.
evidence_note: API completion does not prove audibility or physical action. This tool evaluates recorded claims; it does not verify hardware.
chart_note: Source: supplied sessions, at most first 50 with audible timing. Different declared timing methods must be compared separately.
percentile_note: JSON groups retain clock and timing method. p95 is omitted below 20 audible samples; percentiles use nearest rank.
invalid_file: Cannot read valid UTF-8 JSON from this file.
object_fields: Object has missing or unknown fields.
identifier: Use a short public alphanumeric identifier.
number: Expected a finite non-negative number in range.
file_size_type: Expected a regular file no larger than 2 MiB.
schema: Unsupported schema or invalid synthetic flag.
audible_origin: Audible timing needs an operator or acoustic observation.
time_order: Events must be in non-decreasing time order.
request_zero: The first event must be the request at time zero.
check_method: Check method does not support this claim.
conflicting_audible: Audible timing conflicts with the audibility check.
ha_timestamp: Expected an ISO timestamp with time zone.
unsupported_platform: Safe file loading requires OS support for O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK.
